title: Hal Puthoff starts the government's psychic spy program at SRI

plain: Hal Puthoff is a laser physicist. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s, at the Stanford Research Institute in California, Puthoff started the US government's psychic spy programme, and elsewhere says he ran it for the CIA, the US spy agency, and calls him the founding architect of Stargate, the name of that programme. A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, says Puthoff is a friend who has told him a lot about Stargate, which he says ran until 1995, and names others in it: Paul Smith, Ingo Swann and Joe McMoneagle. If true, it would mean the government paid people to try to see distant places with their minds.
